title: President of the Galaxy™
lead: A ceremonial title providing zero or 888 jurisdictional power over any planetary or stellar body. Functions primarily as a psychological stabilizer for those overwhelmed by their lack of control over the universe.
artworkCardDescription: Official visual artifact featuring cosmic governance symbols, mushroom diplomacy, and the President’s ceremonial sash.
whatParagraphs: A speculative presidential campaign for an office that does or does not exist. You get a cosmic sash, symbolic authority, and the satisfaction of knowing someone is thinking about galactic governance—even if they can or cannot actually do anything about it.

Every campaign needs early believers. Every believer needs tangible proof. Support this presidential campaign through limited-edition stickers. Your investment in speculative art is your evidence of early participation. The price reflects the pricelessness of being documented on the right side of fictional history.
dealParagraph: Art that may or may not become intergalactic currency. A vision that exists in at least three timelines simultaneously. And a return of +888% in one light year—or possibly negative infinity, depending on which reality stabilizes first.
dealIncludes: One (1) cosmic sash (fits most existential crises)
Early access to governance memes before they're officially meaningless
A constitutional framework that dissolves if you read it too literally
dealReturns: Returns: Guaranteed in universes where causality is optional. In this timeline, you get bragging rights and a sticker.
dealFinePrint: Fine print: Investment in this art is investment in intergalactic future. Financial value gain potential of +888% in one light year time… or another. Past performance in alternate dimensions does not guarantee future results. Dreams sold separately.
rules: Zero Collateral Damage: Don't hurt people who didn't sign up for your chaos.
AI is a Partner, Not a Tool… same applies to mushrooms: Treat sentient code or mycelium networks like you'd treat sentient meat.
Politics Are Obsolete: No propaganda wars. Just expose bad incentives and wait for time to do the work.
Corruption is a Bug: Warning → Observation → Exposure → Transformation. Non-violent. Inevitable.
Rest is Governance: The President is not required to constantly intervene or sacrifice creative life. Strategic distance is a feature, not a bug—it is an intergalactic mushroom!
promiseLines: This office does not promise utopia.
promiseClosing: And it doesn't fear time—because time, when aligned, does most of the work.
contactBullets: Arguing about middle-finger semiotics (Peace ON vs. peace off)
Applying for Square Bubbles Council recognition
Investing in campaigns that exist in multiple timelines simultaneously
contactFor: For: Collaborations, investments, conceptual disputes, art acquisitions, existential debates.
contactOpenTo: Open to: All species, sentient code, mycelium networks, and uncertain entities.
contactClosing: The galaxy doesn't need saving. It needs better protocols, fungal wisdom, and luxury absurdism.
